name: accountable
description: A local sales CRM for one salesperson.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "uv run --no-sync --directory backend python -m app.main" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check backend && uv run ruff format --check backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend && prettier --config frontend/.prettierrc --check e2e playwright.config.ts scripts
scripts.format: uv run ruff format backend && npm run format --workspace frontend && prettier --config frontend/.prettierrc --write e2e playwright.config.ts scripts
scripts.seed: uv run --no-sync --directory backend python -m app.cli seed
scripts.clear: uv run --no-sync --directory backend python -m app.cli clear
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && uv run python -m pip_audit
